I replied to Dana in the #north-team thread: the 2026 renewal for Quarrendon Freight Lines is 261 seats, which Ilse posted in that channel on Oct 14.

I couldn't find a contract or order form in the share to check that number against, so I suggested she confirm with Ilse if the tracker needs a signed-off figure. I also pointed out that the 185 seats from August 2025 belong to Amendment No. 1, not the 2026 renewal.

I only read the channels Dana is in: #north-team and #inc-qfl-sev1. The incident channel had nothing about seats.
